<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="inference-functions" name="Event-Driven Inference Functions Architecture"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="2800" pageHeight="2360" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=28;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0f172a;" value="Event-Driven Inference Functions Architecture" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="2720" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=14;fontColor=#334155;" value="Aroma Pacífico Pilot (us-east-1 | docs/inference-functions.md): Four triggers, SQS buffering, managed Bedrock inference (Amazon Nova Pro), result records, failure handling (retries & DLQs), and error observation point." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="2720" x="40" y="62" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="banner_account" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1e293b;strokeColor=#0f172a;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=left;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="AWS Workload Account: production (pdn) | Region: us-east-1 (N. Virginia, USA) | All objects stored & processed in us-east-1 (ASM-002, PD-013) | Bedrock in-Region on-demand, zero cross-Region profiles" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="1740" x="40" y="102" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_azure" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#334155;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Azure: Prepared, not deployed | 10.88.0.0/13 | ADR-001" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="440" x="1800" y="102" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_badges" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=center;" value="Traceability Badges: [ D10 Inference ] [ D09 Ingestion ] [ D06 Security ]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="500" x="2260" y="102" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col1_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="TRIGGERS & INGESTION PIPELINES (Section 3)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1430" width="460" x="40" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_drone_source" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=6;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=45;" value="Contracted Drone Operator Ground Station (ASM-140)
• Ingress: Support VLAN 102 (10.4x.2.10) to private S3 endpoints
• Flights: Confirmation, Verification, Estimation missions
• Pre-Upload Screen: On-device detector screens all frames (ASM-164)
• Uploads: Flight record, manifest, and raw imagery to S3
• Reception Function (A15): Validates checksums and links objects" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="145" width="430" x="55" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_drone_source" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="Reception" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="435" y="218" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_dynamo_missions" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=6;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=45;" value="Amazon DynamoDB: missions Table (ASM-149)
• Reception writes record_persisted in atomic transaction
• DynamoDB Stream captures mission status change (single reader)
• Stream Payload: Identifiers only (mission_id, farm_id, case_id)
• Zero raw imagery or personal data in event stream" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="430" x="55" y="390" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_dynamo_missions" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#2E27AD;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.dynamodb;" value="Missions" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="435" y="398" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_eb_pipe" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=60;" value="Amazon EventBridge Pipe (ASM-161)
• Reads DynamoDB Stream from missions table
• Filter pattern: status = record_persisted
• Upstream Pipe DLQ: SQS <prefix>-pdn-sqs-pipedlq
• Target: Custom EventBus drone-service" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="430" x="55" y="560" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_eb_pipe" parent="1" style="sketch=0;outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;gradientColor=none;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=none;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;pointerEvents=1;shape=mxgraph.aws4.eventbridge_pipes;" value="Pipes" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="435" y="568" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_eb_bus" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=60;" value="Custom EventBridge Bus: drone-service
• Decoupled event distribution for drone mission lifecycle
• Event Detail-Type: mission_record_persisted
• Subscribers: A21 observability and future platform consumers" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="430" x="55" y="705" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_eb_bus" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.eventbridge;" value="EventBus" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="435" y="713" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_eb_rules" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="EventBridge Routing Rules (One Per Mission Type | ASM-161)

1. Rule: rule-inf-confirmation
 • Pattern: mission_type = confirmation
 • Target: SQS Confirmation Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)

2. Rule: rule-inf-verification
 • Pattern: mission_type = verification
 • Target: SQS Verification Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)

3. Rule: rule-inf-estimation
 • Pattern: mission_type = estimation
 • Target: SQS Estimation Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="215" width="430" x="55" y="845" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_telemetry_trigger" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=6;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=45;" value="TRIGGER 4: TELEMETRY BATCH INGESTION (ADR-003, Section 3 | D09)

Field IoT Nodes (200 Pilot Farms x 2 Nodes | ASM-070)
• Soil & drying sensors; encrypted 24h buffer during outages (ASM-074)
• MQTT over mTLS 1.2+ with per-node X.509 client certificate

AWS IoT Core Regional Ingestion Endpoint (us-east-1 | D09)
• Topic: aroma/telemetry/v1/farms/{farm_id}/nodes/{node_id}/readings
• Zero private cloud IPs consumed (identity-based ingestion | ASM-032)
• Peak harvest load: 3,600 readings/day (scales to 18,000/day at 1,000 farms)

Dual Parallel Topic Rule Actions (PD-112)
• Action 1 (DynamoDB PutItem):
 - Direct write of reading to DynamoDB telemetry table
 - Primary key: node_id (PK), reading_timestamp (SK) | KMS: telemetry
• Action 2 (SQS SendMessage):
 - Forwards reading key and payload to SQS Threshold Queue
 - Decoupled ingestion; function reads stored reading with strongly
 consistent GetItem from DynamoDB
• Error Action (SQS SendMessage):
 - If Action 1 or 2 fails, payload routed to <prefix>-pdn-sqs-ioterror
 - Monitored by Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="485" width="430" x="55" y="1085" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_iot_core" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#7AA116;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.iot_core;" value="IoT Core" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="435" y="1093" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col2_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="SQS BUFFERING & RETRIES (Section 6.1)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1430" width="390" x="610" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_conf" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="1. CONFIRMATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infconfirm
• Batch size: 1 message (1 mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s (6x 300 s Lambda timeout)
• KMS Key: records (ASM-097)
• Backoff: 60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s | maxReceiveCount: 5

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infconfirmdlq
• Retention: 14 days (maximum SQS window)
• KMS Key: records
• Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq (depth > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="225" width="360" x="625" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_conf" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="935" y="218" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_ver" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="2. VERIFICATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infverify
• Batch size: 1 message (1 verification mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s (6x Lambda timeout)
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s | maxReceiveCount: 5

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infverifydlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infverifydlq (depth > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="225" width="360" x="625" y="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_ver" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="935" y="458" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_est" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="3. ESTIMATION SQS QUEUE
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infestimate
• Batch size: 1 message (1 estimation mission)
• Visibility timeout: 1,800 s
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 60 s, 120 s, 240 s, 480 s | maxReceiveCount: 5

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infestimatedlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq (depth > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="225" width="360" x="625" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_est" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="935" y="698" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_thresh" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="4. TELEMETRY THRESHOLD QUEUE (D10 / B10)
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infthreshold
• Batch size: 10 readings (batch) | Window: 0 s
• Partial batch failures: ReportBatchItemFailures
• Visibility timeout: 360 s (6x 60 s Lambda timeout)
• KMS Key: records
• Backoff: 10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s
 (transient retries stay within 5-min alert budget)
• maxReceiveCount: 5 attempts

Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ):
Queue: <prefix>-pdn-sqs-infthresholddlq
• Retention: 14 days | KMS Key: records
• Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq (depth > 0)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="285" width="360" x="625" y="930" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sqs_thresh" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sqs;" value="SQS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="935" y="938" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sqs_redrive" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="OPERATOR REDRIVE & UPSTREAM DLQS
• Manual SQS DLQ Redrive: Platform operator redrives
 messages to source queue after root cause resolution.
• Safe Replay: Functions are 100% idempotent (Section 6.3);
 duplicate redrive finds existing result and exits cleanly
 without re-invoking Bedrock model.
• Upstream Delivery DLQs:
 - EventBridge Pipe DLQ: captures stream delivery drops
 - EventBridge Rule Target DLQs: captures target drops
 - IoT Rule Error Queue: captures failed telemetry writes
 - Monitored by Alarm: <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
• 14-Day Retention: Alarms fire on FIRST message visible." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="340" width="360" x="625" y="1230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col3_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#0284c7;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0c4a6e;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="EVENT-DRIVEN INFERENCE FUNCTIONS (Sections 4 & 11 | Non-VPC | D06, D10)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1430" width="600" x="1090" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_contract" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#0284c7;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="COMMON 7-STEP FUNCTION CONTRACT (Section 4.1):
1. Receive: Read SQS event (identifiers only; zero personal data)
2. Idempotency Check: Query result by key; if exists, delete message & stop
3. Guard Check: Verify case/order/mission state; if invalid, record guard_skipped
4. Read Input: S3 GetObject (exact SHA-256) / DynamoDB; verify person_screen = clear
5. Invoke Bedrock: Call Converse API on Nova Pro (us-east-1) with JSON schema
6. Persist: TransactWriteItems: write result record + conditional state transition
7. Finish: Delete SQS message, emit CloudWatch metrics, log structured JSON audit" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="570" x="1105" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_conf" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="FUNCTION 1: OUTBREAK CONFIRMATION (inf-confirmation | Section 4.2)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5 (bounds spend)
• Guard: Case in confirming; mission is confirmation with record_persisted
• Reads: S3 photos/ by version & SHA-256 with person_screen = clear (KMS objects)
• Model Input: Up to 8 focus photos (ASM-168) and alert environment context
• Model Output: pest_signs_present (bool), signs, person_detected, confidence [0, 1]
• Decision: focus_confirmed if pest_signs_present = true & confidence >= 0.70 (ASM-163);
 else focus_not_confirmed. If no image usable -> outcome not_evaluable
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes confirmation_result to pest case;
 transitions confirming -> confirmed or confirming -> not_confirmed
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER authorizes or creates a fumigation order! Authorizer
 is strictly human agronomist with MFA only (A09 Section 4.3)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="570" x="1105" y="365" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_conf" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-confirmation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="1625" y="373" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_ver" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="FUNCTION 2: FUMIGATION VERIFICATION (inf-verification | Section 4.3)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard: Case in verifying; fumigation order in executed; mission is verification
• Reads: S3 photos/ (up to 8 short-pass frames, person_screen = clear) & track/
 geometry (track verified locally in Lambda; track NOT sent to Bedrock)
• Model Input: Up to 8 frames, confirmation result of the case for comparison
• Model Output: active_signs_at_focus (bool), person_detected, confidence [0, 1]
• Decision: can_close if pass covered focus, active_signs = false, confidence >= 0.70;
 else cannot_close. If no usable image -> not_evaluable
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes verification_results;
 transitions verifying -> closed or verifying -> verification_not_closable
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER closes case without persisted verification object!" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="570" x="1105" y="610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_ver" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-verification" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="1625" y="618" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_est" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="FUNCTION 3: HARVEST ESTIMATION (inf-estimation | Section 4.4)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard: Farm has active polygon version; mission is estimation with record_persisted
• Reads: S3 photos/ (up to 20 plot photos) & maps/ (1 plot map) (person_screen = clear)
• Model Input: Up to 20 photos and 1 plot map (ASM-168) with evaluation prompt
• Model Output: Per plot: productive_cover_fraction [0, 1], crop_load_class
• Decision: Formula: estimated_sacks = area_ha x cover x yield_factor(load_class)
 Farm estimate is sum over plots with low/high bounds (ASM-166)
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes harvest_estimate record in
 estimates table; updates Collection Center expected-sacks view
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER creates packing orders, sacks, or code batches!" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="570" x="1105" y="855" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_est" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-estimation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="1625" y="863" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_fn_thresh" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="FUNCTION 4: TELEMETRY THRESHOLD (inf-threshold | Section 4.5 | D10 / B10)
• Config: Memory 256 MB | Timeout 60 s | Concurrency 10 | Batch size 10
• Reads: Strongly consistent GetItem on DynamoDB telemetry table by key
 (retried 3x if not present: 200, 400, 800 ms; then backoff to queue).
 Queries active threshold version from thresholds table (zero cache). KMS telemetry.
• Rules Engine (Federation Rules): Evaluated first against dynamic ranges
 (T-01..T-10) with confidence 1.0 (confidence_basis = rule). Evaluation item
 written conditional on attribute_not_exists.
• Notification Dispatch (< 5-min SLA Budget): Alert event published to Amazon
 SNS Alert Topic immediately on episode opening, reminder, closure, or resolution.
 Notification dispatch proceeds immediately without waiting for Bedrock.
• Bedrock Plausibility Check (ASM-167): ONLY invoked for a reading opening
 an episode, and ONLY AFTER alert published to SNS! Bedrock Nova Pro checks
 reading against 24h context. Plausibility written onto existing evaluation item.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Bedrock NEVER suppresses, delays, or alters an alert!
 If model fails, plausibility = unavailable (batch succeeds). Zero write on telemetry." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="570" x="1105" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_fn_thresh" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#ED7100;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.lambda;" value="inf-threshold" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="1625" y="1108" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col4_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#064e3b;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="MANAGED INFERENCE & DATA STORES (Sections 2, 5, 8, 10)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1430" width="460" x="1820" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_bedrock" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#059669;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="AMAZON BEDROCK RUNTIME (us-east-1 | ASM-160)

• Model: Amazon Nova Pro (amazon.nova-pro-v1:0)
 In-Region vision-capable foundation model in us-east-1
• Mode: On-demand per request via Converse API
• Zero Persistent Compute: Zero training, zero fine-tuning,
 no provisioned throughput, no SageMaker endpoints (Part E)
• Prompts: Versioned zero-shot system prompts in config;
 structured JSON schema; confidence in [0, 1]
• Guardrails (PD-013): bedrock:InvokeModel permitted ONLY on
 arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0;
 explicit DENY on cross-Region profiles (inference-profile/*)
• Zero Model Training: Terms guarantee data never trains base FMs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="295" width="430" x="1835" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_bedrock" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#01A88D;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.bedrock;" value="Nova Pro" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="2215" y="218" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_stores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2E27AD;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="DYNAMODB TRANSACTIONAL STORES (Section 5)

Destination Tables (KMS Key: records | 5-Year Object Lock):
• cases table: confirmation_result, verification_results
• estimates table: harvest_estimate for farm & campaign
• alerts table (Alert Store): evaluation_item, episode
• telemetry table: strongly consistent read for batch readings

Standardized Result Record Schema:
• result_id: Idempotency key ({function}#{mission_id} or reading key)
• function, outcome, result_at (UTC timestamp)
• confidence [0, 1], confidence_basis (model | rule)
• source: S3 bucket, key, version, SHA-256 or DynamoDB key
• excluded_objects: Key, version, exclusion reason
• model_id, model_region, prompt_version, bedrock_request_id
• input_tokens, output_tokens, event_id (trigger identifier)

Atomicity: TransactWriteItems writes result conditional on
attribute_not_exists(result_id) AND case/order state guard." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="355" width="430" x="1835" y="520" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_stores" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#2E27AD;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.dynamodb;" value="Records" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="2215" y="528" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_s3_privacy" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#e11d48;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=90;" value="S3 OBJECT STORAGE & PRIVACY (Sections 2, 10)

S3 Drone Bucket Prefixes (KMS Customer Key: objects):
• photos/, track/, maps/ (5-year Object Lock retention)
• Versioning enabled; SHA-256 verified; NO PutObject/DeleteObject
 for functions: the source object remains permanent!

Person Privacy Controls (Section 10):
If an object contains a person, it is never sent to inference,
and file handling is documented and audited.
1. Detection Before Upload: Ground station on-device detector
 screens photos before upload (ASM-164); person_screen flag.
2. Platform Fail-Closed: Only clear objects sent to Bedrock.
3. S3 Restricted Storage (ASM-165): Reception function moves
 person_present objects to:
 restricted/person/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key}
 Encrypted with dedicated KMS customer key: restricted (8th key).
 Explicit DENY on restricted/* for all inference roles.
4. Cloud Backstop: If Bedrock returns person_detected = true,
 result is discarded (outcome = not_evaluable), object moved to
 restricted/, and ModelPersonDetected alarm fires." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="430" x="1835" y="890" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_s3" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#7AA116;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.s3;" value="S3" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="2170" y="898" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_kms_restricted" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#DD344C;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.key_management_service;" value="Restricted" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="2215" y="898" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_sns" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=55;" value="AMAZON SNS: ALERT TOPIC (A14 / ADR-003)
• Topic: <prefix>-pdn-sns-alerts (KMS records)
• Immediate publication on episode opening, reminder, closure
• Decoupled from Bedrock: Farmer push and SMS dispatched
 immediately, meeting < 5-min SLA budget (Hop 5: 20 s target)
 without waiting for inference." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="205" width="430" x="1835" y="1365" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_sns" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.sns;" value="SNS Alerts" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="2215" y="1373" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="col5_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="ERROR OBSERVATION & ALARMS (Section 7)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1430" width="400" x="2360" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_obs_signals" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=65;" value="ERROR OBSERVATION ARCHITECTURE (Section 7)

State Invariance & Reliability Contract:
If invocation fails, the source object remains permanent and
the case state does not change. The design defines retries,
dead-letter queues, and centralized error observation.

Observation Principles:
• Dual Observation Locus: The observation point is the
 function DLQ TOGETHER WITH missions reaching
 record_persisted without a result (catches upstream drops).
• Immediate Alarm on First Failure: Alarms trigger on
 ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0 (14-day limit).
• Decoupled Operational Surface: Feeds A21 dashboard.
• Structured JSON Logging: CloudWatch Logs under KMS logs;
 records event_id, outcome, result_id, model ID, error class
 (zero personal data, zero image payloads)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="370" x="2375" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_obs_signals" parent="1" style="sketch=0;points=[[0,0,0],[0.25,0,0],[0.5,0,0],[0.75,0,0],[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[0.25,1,0],[0.5,1,0],[0.75,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0.25,0],[0,0.5,0],[0,0.75,0],[1,0.25,0],[1,0.5,0],[1,0.75,0]];outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#E7157B;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=11;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.cloudwatch_2;" value="Observation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="40" x="2670" y="218" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_alarms" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="PROPOSED CLOUDWATCH ALARMS FOR A21 (PC-IAC-003)

1. Dead-Letter Queue Depth (MessagesVisible > 0):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq (Confirmation DLQ depth > 0)
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infverifydlq (Verification DLQ depth > 0)
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq (Estimation DLQ depth > 0)
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq (Threshold DLQ depth > 0)

2. Upstream Event Ingestion & Routing Drop:
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
 Monitors EventBridge Pipe DLQ, Rule Target DLQs,
 and FailedInvocations metric.

3. Oldest Message Age (Queue Processing Lag):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-inf{confirm,verify,estimate,threshold}age
 Monitors ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on primary queues.

4. Invocations Failed Without State Change (State Invariance):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-inffailed
 Custom metric: InferenceFailed in AromaPacifico/Inference.

5. Missions Awaiting Result (Pipeline Disconnect):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infawaiting
 Custom metric: MissionsAwaitingResult (> timeout threshold).

6. Reading Not Persisted Before Evaluation:
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore
 Custom metric: ReadingNotPersisted & IoT error queue depth.

7. Bedrock Model Throttling & Quotas:
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infthrottle
 Monitors AWS/Bedrock throttles & metric InferenceThrottled.

8. Person Detected in Crop Object (Privacy Incident):
 • <prefix>-pdn-alarm-infperson
 Custom metric: ModelPersonDetected > 0 (operator incident)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="860" width="370" x="2375" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_sovereignty" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="DATA SOVEREIGNTY: WHAT LEAVES COLOMBIA (Section 8.2 | PD-013, ASM-002)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="710" width="880" x="40" y="1610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sub_sovereignty" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;" value="No AWS Region exists in Colombia (ADR-001). Batch does NOT fail" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="280" x="1720" y="1946" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_matrix_notes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="Idempotency Mechanics (Section 6.3):
• Drone Functions: result_id = {function}#{mission_id}. Conditional put prevents duplicate result; transaction verifies source state.
• Telemetry Function: result_id = {node_id}#{variable}#{reading_timestamp}. Conditional put prevents duplicate episode opening.
• SQS Dead-Letter Redrive: Safe to redrive at any time; duplicate event finds existing result and deletes itself without calling model." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="290" width="1040" x="960" y="2015" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_citations" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=25;spacingTop=10;" value="IaC TRACEABILITY, HARVEST VOLUMES & CITATIONS (Sections 9, 11, 13, 14)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="710" width="720" x="2040" y="1610" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_iac_boxes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="Track B / IaC Box Traceability (docs/architecture.md Section 14)
• D10 (#30 / B10): Event-Driven Inference Function Pattern
 Coded pattern of Epic 6: SQS threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS topic, Bedrock plausibility check, DLQs.
• D09 (#29 / B09): Telemetry Ingestion Pattern Module (ADR-003)
 AWS IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, IoT rule error SQS queue.
• D06 (#26 / B06): Identities & KMS Customer Keys
 IAM Lambda execution roles (least privilege), KMS keys: records, telemetry, objects, logs, restricted.
 (Note: D04 is omitted because inference functions are not VPC-attached)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="690" x="2055" y="1655" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_harvest_volumes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="Harvest Volume & Spend Drivers (Section 9 | ASM-168, ASM-169)
• Telemetry: 108,000 readings/harvest month (200 farms x 6/day + 100 farms x 24/day); Bedrock called ONLY on episode openings.
• Confirmation: ~1/alert; up to 8 focus photos.
• Verification: ~1/fumigation; up to 8 short-pass frames.
• Estimation: 200 flights/campaign (1/farm/harvest campaign); up to 20 plot photos + 1 plot map.
• Cost Controls: On-demand Bedrock (zero idle compute), idempotency avoids re-invocation, image caps enforce predictable token budgets." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="185" width="690" x="2055" y="1840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_decision_citations" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;spacingLeft=22;spacingTop=10;" value="Normative Decision-Log Citations (docs/decision-log.md)
• ASM-160 (Bedrock Nova Pro us-east-1) • ASM-161 (Delivery paths & SQS decoupling)
• ASM-162 (Failure parameters & backoff) • ASM-163 (0.70 confidence threshold)
• ASM-164 (On-device person detector) • ASM-165 (Restricted prefix & key)
• ASM-166 (Estimation formula & factors) • ASM-167 (Telemetry plausibility on openings)
• ASM-168 (Image caps per invocation) • ASM-169 (Named pricing parameters for A23)
• PD-013 (Closed: Region & Colombia exit) • PD-014 (Closed: Retries, DLQ & observation)
• PD-015 (Closed: Person object handling) • PD-111 (Closed: Persisted object trigger)
• PD-112 (Closed: Telemetry store coupling) • PD-135 (Closed: A14 evaluation contract)
• PD-161 (Closed: B10 telemetry pattern) • PD-018 (Open: AWS live feature re-check)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="270" width="690" x="2055" y="2035" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell div.div:
EventBridge Routing Rules (One Per Mission Type | ASM-161)
1. Rule: rule-inf-confirmation
• Pattern: mission_type = confirmation
• Target: SQS Confirmation Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)
2. Rule: rule-inf-verification
• Pattern: mission_type = verification
• Target: SQS Verification Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)
3. Rule: rule-inf-estimation
• Pattern: mission_type = estimation
• Target: SQS Estimation Queue (retry 2x, target DLQ)

div.div:
TRIGGER 4: TELEMETRY BATCH INGESTION (ADR-003, Section 3 | D09)
Field IoT Nodes (200 Pilot Farms x 2 Nodes | ASM-070)
• Soil & drying sensors; encrypted 24h buffer during outages (ASM-074)
• MQTT over mTLS 1.2+ with per-node X.509 client certificate
AWS IoT Core Regional Ingestion Endpoint (us-east-1 | D09)
• Topic: aroma/telemetry/v1/farms/{farm_id}/nodes/{node_id}/readings
• Zero private cloud IPs consumed (identity-based ingestion | ASM-032)
• Peak harvest load: 3,600 readings/day (scales to 18,000/day at 1,000 farms)
Dual Parallel Topic Rule Actions (PD-112)
• Action 1 (DynamoDB PutItem):
- Direct write of reading to DynamoDB telemetry table
- Primary key: node_id (PK), reading_timestamp (SK) | KMS: telemetry
• Action 2 (SQS SendMessage):
- Forwards reading key and payload to SQS Threshold Queue
- Decoupled ingestion; function reads stored reading with strongly
consistent GetItem from DynamoDB
• Error Action (SQS SendMessage):
- If Action 1 or 2 fails, payload routed to -pdn-sqs-ioterror
- Monitored by Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore

text.tspan: Field IoT Nodes (200 Pilot Farms x 2 Nodes | ASM-070)

div.div:
OPERATOR REDRIVE & UPSTREAM DLQS
• Manual SQS DLQ Redrive: Platform operator redrives
messages to source queue after root cause resolution.
• Safe Replay: Functions are 100% idempotent (Section 6.3);
duplicate redrive finds existing result and exits cleanly
without re-invoking Bedrock model.
• Upstream Delivery DLQs:
- EventBridge Pipe DLQ: captures stream delivery drops
- EventBridge Rule Target DLQs: captures target drops
- IoT Rule Error Queue: captures failed telemetry writes
- Monitored by Alarm: -pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
• 14-Day Retention: Alarms fire on FIRST message visible.

div.div:
COMMON 7-STEP FUNCTION CONTRACT (Section 4.1):
1. Receive: Read SQS event (identifiers only; zero personal data)
2. Idempotency Check: Query result by key; if exists, delete message & stop
3. Guard Check: Verify case/order/mission state; if invalid, record guard_skipped
4. Read Input: S3 GetObject (exact SHA-256) / DynamoDB; verify person_screen = clear
5. Invoke Bedrock: Call Converse API on Nova Pro (us-east-1) with JSON schema
6. Persist: TransactWriteItems: write result record + conditional state transition
7. Finish: Delete SQS message, emit CloudWatch metrics, log structured JSON audit

div.div:
FUNCTION 1: OUTBREAK CONFIRMATION (inf-confirmation | Section 4.2)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5 (bounds spend)
• Guard: Case in confirming; mission is confirmation with record_persisted
• Reads: S3 photos/ by version & SHA-256 with person_screen = clear (KMS objects)
• Model Input: Up to 8 focus photos (ASM-168) and alert environment context
• Model Output: pest_signs_present (bool), signs, person_detected, confidence [0, 1]
• Decision: focus_confirmed if pest_signs_present = true & confidence >= 0.70 (ASM-163);
else focus_not_confirmed. If no image usable -> outcome not_evaluable
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes confirmation_result to pest case;
transitions confirming -> confirmed or confirming -> not_confirmed
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER authorizes or creates a fumigation order! Authorizer
is strictly human agronomist with MFA only (A09 Section 4.3).

div.div:
FUNCTION 2: FUMIGATION VERIFICATION (inf-verification | Section 4.3)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard: Case in verifying; fumigation order in executed; mission is verification
• Reads: S3 photos/ (up to 8 short-pass frames, person_screen = clear) & track/
geometry (track verified locally in Lambda; track NOT sent to Bedrock)
• Model Input: Up to 8 frames, confirmation result of the case for comparison
• Model Output: active_signs_at_focus (bool), person_detected, confidence [0, 1]
• Decision: can_close if pass covered focus, active_signs = false, confidence >= 0.70;
else cannot_close. If no usable image -> not_evaluable
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes verification_results;
transitions verifying -> closed or verifying -> verification_not_closable
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER closes case without persisted verification object!

div.div:
FUNCTION 3: HARVEST ESTIMATION (inf-estimation | Section 4.4)
• Config: Memory 512 MB | Timeout 300 s | Reserved Concurrency 5
• Guard: Farm has active polygon version; mission is estimation with record_persisted
• Reads: S3 photos/ (up to 20 plot photos) & maps/ (1 plot map) (person_screen = clear)
• Model Input: Up to 20 photos and 1 plot map (ASM-168) with evaluation prompt
• Model Output: Per plot: productive_cover_fraction [0, 1], crop_load_class
• Decision: Formula: estimated_sacks = area_ha x cover x yield_factor(load_class)
Farm estimate is sum over plots with low/high bounds (ASM-166)
• Persistence: DynamoDB TransactWriteItems: writes harvest_estimate record in
estimates table; updates Collection Center expected-sacks view
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: NEVER creates packing orders, sacks, or code batches!

div.div:
FUNCTION 4: TELEMETRY THRESHOLD (inf-threshold | Section 4.5 | D10 / B10)
• Config: Memory 256 MB | Timeout 60 s | Concurrency 10 | Batch size 10
• Reads: Strongly consistent GetItem on DynamoDB telemetry table by key
(retried 3x if not present: 200, 400, 800 ms; then backoff to queue).
Queries active threshold version from thresholds table (zero cache). KMS telemetry.
• Rules Engine (Federation Rules): Evaluated first against dynamic ranges
(T-01..T-10) with confidence 1.0 (confidence_basis = rule). Evaluation item
written conditional on attribute_not_exists.
• Notification Dispatch (< 5-min SLA Budget): Alert event published to Amazon
SNS Alert Topic immediately on episode opening, reminder, closure, or resolution.
Notification dispatch proceeds immediately without waiting for Bedrock.
• Bedrock Plausibility Check (ASM-167): ONLY invoked for a reading opening
an episode, and ONLY AFTER alert published to SNS! Bedrock Nova Pro checks
reading against 24h context. Plausibility written onto existing evaluation item.
• CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Bedrock NEVER suppresses, delays, or alters an alert!
If model fails, plausibility = unavailable (batch succeeds). Zero write on telemetry.

div.div:
AMAZON BEDROCK RUNTIME (us-east-1 | ASM-160)
• Model: Amazon Nova Pro (amazon.nova-pro-v1:0)
In-Region vision-capable foundation model in us-east-1
• Mode: On-demand per request via Converse API
• Zero Persistent Compute: Zero training, zero fine-tuning,
no provisioned throughput, no SageMaker endpoints (Part E)
• Prompts: Versioned zero-shot system prompts in config;
structured JSON schema; confidence in [0, 1]
• Guardrails (PD-013): bedrock:InvokeModel permitted ONLY on
arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1::foundation-model/amazon.nova-pro-v1:0;
explicit DENY on cross-Region profiles (inference-profile/*)
• Zero Model Training: Terms guarantee data never trains base FMs

div.div:
DYNAMODB TRANSACTIONAL STORES (Section 5)
Destination Tables (KMS Key: records | 5-Year Object Lock):
• cases table: confirmation_result, verification_results
• estimates table: harvest_estimate for farm & campaign
• alerts table (Alert Store): evaluation_item, episode
• telemetry table: strongly consistent read for batch readings
Standardized Result Record Schema:
• result_id: Idempotency key ({function}#{mission_id} or reading key)
• function, outcome, result_at (UTC timestamp)
• confidence [0, 1], confidence_basis (model | rule)
• source: S3 bucket, key, version, SHA-256 or DynamoDB key
• excluded_objects: Key, version, exclusion reason
• model_id, model_region, prompt_version, bedrock_request_id
• input_tokens, output_tokens, event_id (trigger identifier)
Atomicity: TransactWriteItems writes result conditional on
attribute_not_exists(result_id) AND case/order state guard.

div.div:
S3 OBJECT STORAGE & PRIVACY (Sections 2, 10)
S3 Drone Bucket Prefixes (KMS Customer Key: objects):
• photos/, track/, maps/ (5-year Object Lock retention)
• Versioning enabled; SHA-256 verified; NO PutObject/DeleteObject
for functions: the source object remains permanent!
Person Privacy Controls (Section 10):
If an object contains a person, it is never sent to inference,
and file handling is documented and audited.
1. Detection Before Upload: Ground station on-device detector
screens photos before upload (ASM-164); person_screen flag.
2. Platform Fail-Closed: Only clear objects sent to Bedrock.
3. S3 Restricted Storage (ASM-165): Reception function moves
person_present objects to:
restricted/person/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{original_key}
Encrypted with dedicated KMS customer key: restricted (8th key).
Explicit DENY on restricted/* for all inference roles.
4. Cloud Backstop: If Bedrock returns person_detected = true,
result is discarded (outcome = not_evaluable), object moved to
restricted/, and ModelPersonDetected alarm fires.

div.div:
ERROR OBSERVATION ARCHITECTURE (Section 7)
State Invariance & Reliability Contract:
If invocation fails, the source object remains permanent and
the case state does not change. The design defines retries,
dead-letter queues, and centralized error observation.
Observation Principles:
• Dual Observation Locus: The observation point is the
function DLQ TOGETHER WITH missions reaching
record_persisted without a result (catches upstream drops).
• Immediate Alarm on First Failure: Alarms trigger on
ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible > 0 (14-day limit).
• Decoupled Operational Surface: Feeds A21 dashboard.
• Structured JSON Logging: CloudWatch Logs under KMS logs;
records event_id, outcome, result_id, model ID, error class
(zero personal data, zero image payloads).

div.div:
PROPOSED CLOUDWATCH ALARMS FOR A21 (PC-IAC-003)
1. Dead-Letter Queue Depth (MessagesVisible > 0):
• -pdn-alarm-infconfirmdlq (Confirmation DLQ depth > 0)
• -pdn-alarm-infverifydlq (Verification DLQ depth > 0)
• -pdn-alarm-infestimatedlq (Estimation DLQ depth > 0)
• -pdn-alarm-infthresholddlq (Threshold DLQ depth > 0)
2. Upstream Event Ingestion & Routing Drop:
• -pdn-alarm-infroutedlq
Monitors EventBridge Pipe DLQ, Rule Target DLQs,
and FailedInvocations metric.
3. Oldest Message Age (Queue Processing Lag):
• -pdn-alarm-inf{confirm,verify,estimate,threshold}age
Monitors ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage on primary queues.
4. Invocations Failed Without State Change (State Invariance):
• -pdn-alarm-inffailed
Custom metric: InferenceFailed in AromaPacifico/Inference.
5. Missions Awaiting Result (Pipeline Disconnect):
• -pdn-alarm-infawaiting
Custom metric: MissionsAwaitingResult (> timeout threshold).
6. Reading Not Persisted Before Evaluation:
• -pdn-alarm-infthresholdstore
Custom metric: ReadingNotPersisted & IoT error queue depth.
7. Bedrock Model Throttling & Quotas:
• -pdn-alarm-infthrottle
Monitors AWS/Bedrock throttles & metric InferenceThrottled.
8. Person Detected in Crop Object (Privacy Incident):
• -pdn-alarm-infperson
Custom metric: ModelPersonDetected > 0 (operator incident).

div.div:
Legal & Compliance Safeguards:
• Transfer of Colombian agricultural data to USA is submitted to the Federation under Question Q-02 and PD-101.
• Personal Data Isolation: Stored in personal-data table encrypted with KMS personal; no inference function role holds this key.
• Bedrock Terms: Amazon Bedrock does not use customer prompts or completions to train base foundation models.

div.div:
Idempotency Mechanics (Section 6.3):
• Drone Functions: result_id = {function}#{mission_id}. Conditional put prevents duplicate result; transaction verifies source state.
• Telemetry Function: result_id = {node_id}#{variable}#{reading_timestamp}. Conditional put prevents duplicate episode opening.
• SQS Dead-Letter Redrive: Safe to redrive at any time; duplicate event finds existing result and deletes itself without calling model.

text.tspan: • Drone Functions: result_id = {function}#{mission_id}. Conditional put prevents duplicate result; transaction verifies source state.
• Telemetry Function: result_id = {node_id}#{variable}#{reading_timestamp}. Conditional put prevents duplicate episode opening.
• SQS Dead-Letter Redrive: Safe to redrive at any time; duplicate event finds existing result and deletes itself without calling model.

div.div:
Track B / IaC Box Traceability (docs/architecture.md Section 14)
• D10 (#30 / B10): Event-Driven Inference Function Pattern
Coded pattern of Epic 6: SQS threshold queue, Lambda rules engine, Alert Store, SNS topic, Bedrock plausibility check, DLQs.
• D09 (#29 / B09): Telemetry Ingestion Pattern Module (ADR-003)
AWS IoT Core, topic rules, DynamoDB telemetry table, IoT rule error SQS queue.
• D06 (#26 / B06): Identities & KMS Customer Keys
IAM Lambda execution roles (least privilege), KMS keys: records, telemetry, objects, logs, restricted.
(Note: D04 is omitted because inference functions are not VPC-attached)

div.div:
Harvest Volume & Spend Drivers (Section 9 | ASM-168, ASM-169)
• Telemetry: 108,000 readings/harvest month (200 farms x 6/day + 100 farms x 24/day); Bedrock called ONLY on episode openings.
• Confirmation: ~1/alert; up to 8 focus photos.
• Verification: ~1/fumigation; up to 8 short-pass frames.
• Estimation: 200 flights/campaign (1/farm/harvest campaign); up to 20 plot photos + 1 plot map.
• Cost Controls: On-demand Bedrock (zero idle compute), idempotency avoids re-invocation, image caps enforce predictable token budgets.
